style.backgroundSystem: 深色科技场（碳黑+斜向光痕）与浅色纸纹圆角卡片交替；统一圆角面板语言

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark-tech premium audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of carbon black #1C1C1E, paper white #F7F5F2, light grey panel #E9E9EB with vivid orange #FF5A2C as the only accent; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines with eyebrow small caps and short sublines; alternating dark charcoal tech backdrops with subtle diagonal light streaks and light paper-grain rounded cards; cool studio lighting with metallic rim highlights on chrome surfaces and soft contact shadows; thin-line white icons centered in orange #FF5A2C circular badges with a thin metallic ring; stable chrome product rendering with mirror highlights and a consistent hero angle family; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: 铬金属镜面高光呈现稳定；产品实拍镜位保持 3/4 主视角家族；信息图一律正俯平视版式
style.surfaceSystem: 哑光碳黑舞台+细微纸纹白卡；产品以镜面铬金属质感呈现
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif，眉题小字+大标题+短副文三层，仅短句标题文案
